desc: Introducing the CT5P Patrol Silencer, Dead Air's first patrol-specific, gas-regulated, ultra-lightweight, low-backpressure, compact-Triskelion-baffled 5.56 NATO silencer. Engineered to meet the precise demands of law enforcement officers using semi-automatic duty rifles. It's designed to minimize hearing-loss risk, reduce muzzle concussion in confined environments, and enhance officer survivability.
